scenes.caption: Get everything ready
scenes.narration_line: Keep everything at hand in a warm room.
scenes.evidence: Have everything you need at hand
safety_points: Never leave your baby alone in the bath.

scenes.caption: Check warm water with your wrist
scenes.narration_line: Mix the water well; check with your wrist or elbow.
scenes.evidence: Check it with your wrist or elbow
safety_points: The water should be warm, not hot.

scenes.caption: Support their head and shoulders
scenes.narration_line: Support head and shoulders; gently swish water using your free hand.
safety_points: Hold their upper arm with one hand.

scenes.caption: Keep their head above the water
scenes.narration_line: Keep your baby's head clear of the water.
scenes.evidence: Keep your baby's head clear of the water

scenes.caption: Pat dry, then cover or dress
scenes.narration_line: Pat skin folds dry, then cover or dress your baby.
scenes.evidence: Lift your baby out and pat them dry
safety_points: Keep your baby warm once dry.
